This record was redone from documents read on sec.gov: the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001467858-25-000032) and the 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001467858-25-000084). The earlier pilot's third-party mirror is no longer used. OWNERSHIP: Mary Barra beneficially owned 3,038,678 shares as of April 4, 2025. That includes 1,931,853 shares from options exercisable within 60 days and 385,000 shares held in two grantor retained annuity trusts. The proxy marks it * (less than 1%), so pctEconomic is null. The Vanguard figure rests on a 13G/A reporting holdings as of December 29, 2023, so it is stale; BlackRock's is as of March 31, 2025. DIVIDENDS: $530 million paid on common stock, per Note 20 and the 'Cash dividends paid on common stock' line in the statement of equity. The cash-flow 'Dividends paid' line ($653 million) also includes dividends to noncontrolling interests, so it is not used. BUYBACKS exclude the $101 million 'Issuance (redemption) of subsidiary stock' line. STOCK COMP: $332 million is the stated expense for GM stock incentive awards. Cruise's share-based award expense was described as 'insignificant' in 2024. XBRL also carries $543 million of stock-based compensation in the statement of equity (an APIC adjustment), which is not used. GEOGRAPHY: four rows as reported; the filing gives no combined U.S. / non-U.S. total. The 10-K text contains no mention of an employee stock purchase plan, so plan is null.

footprint.notes: U.S. plants by state: GM's U.S. Operations page (gm.com/company/us-operations) lists its facilities state by state (59 entries; the page says "50 assembly and parts facilities across 19 states" and "97k+ GM employees in the U.S."), but it publishes no count, employment or investment figure per state, so usStates is null rather than a tally made here; 12 of the listed facilities are recorded as sites. That page is current (fetched Nov 2026, newer than the FY2024 snapshot) and lists the Hudson's Detroit headquarters as opened in 2026; the FY2024 10-K cover address is 300 Renaissance Center, Detroit. The FY2024 10-K Item 2 gives only national totals ("over 100 locations in the U.S." and operations "in 33 countries"; major non-U.S. facilities in Brazil, Canada, China, Mexico and South Korea). Employees come from the 10-K table, filed in thousands: GMNA 123 (includes Cruise), GMI 30, GM Financial 9 (not shown), total 162; U.S. salaried 50 and hourly 47 are separate metrics, not added. GMNA and GMI are GM segments with no country list in the 10-K.
